decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents.Location Plan, LP0001BProposed Overview 25X80X6.8 01 dated 29.05.2024Proposed Lateral View 25X80X6.8 02 dated 29.05.2024Proposed Front View 25X80X6.8 03 dated 29.05.2024Proposed Middle Arc View 25X80X6.8 04 dated 29.05.2024Proposed General View 25X80X6.8 05 dated 29.05.2024Proposed Frontal and Back Facades View 25X80X6.8 06 dated 29.05.2024Proposed Lateral Facades View 25X80X6.8 07 dated 29.05.2024Typical Canopy Section PS1010 dated 31.07.2024Club House CH0001 dated 31.07.2024Proposed Elevations PE1010 dated 19.06.2024Wider Context PP1011 dated 07.07.2024Proposed Courts Layout PP1030 dated 19.06.2024Design and Access Statement Southgate Hockey CentrePistas Padel document dated 19.01.2023Flood Light Data sheet FT-21200Biodiversity Net Gain Assessment Arbtech Southgate Hockey Centre dated 14.08.2024Canopy Light Performance Sattler Pro-Tex dated 20.04.2016Planning Note Southgate Hockey Centre dated 06.02.2025Heritage Statement JPHeritage 24/077 dated 04.01.2025Covering Letter, dated 08.08.2025Energy and Sustainability Statement, dated Aug 2025Transport Statement, dated 08.08.2025Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance.

Prior to the commencement of landscaping works full details of any external lighting and any other light sources that may create external light spill shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be occupied unl the external lighting in respect of that phase has been completed in accordance with the approved details. The external lighting shall thereafter be maintained and retained as approved. Reason: To protect the amenity of local residents and future occupants of the development from undue light spillage and to ensure there are no detrimental biodiversity impacts arising as a result of the development.

The development shall not commence until a revised landscaping proposal including details of trees, shrubs and grass to be planted and the treatment of any hard surfaced areas have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The site shall be landscaped in accordance with the approved details in the first planting season after completion or occupation of the development whichever is the sooner. Any trees or shrubs which die, becomes severely damaged or diseased within five years of planting shall be replaced with new planting in accordance with the approved details. Reason: To provide a satisfactory appearance and to enhance biodiversity

The site shall be enclosed in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The means of enclosure shall be erected in accordance with the approved detail before the development is occupied.Reason: To ensure satisfactory appearance and safeguard the privacy, amenity and safety of adjoining occupiers and the public and in the interests of highway safety.

The facility hereby permitted shall not be open to customers and associated floodlighting shall not be used outside the following times:Monday to Friday: 07:00 to 22:00 Saturday, Sunday and Public Holidays: 07:00 to 21:00 Reason: To ensure neighbouring residential amenity is not unduly impacted.

Prior to occupation, details of cycle parking shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details should demonstrate the provision of at least 15 short-stay and 5 long-stay cycle parking spaces in accordance with the London Plan (2021) standards across the whole site. Any existing cycle parking spaces within the site may contribute towards this requirement, provided they meet London Cycling Design Standards (LCDS) in terms of security, accessibility, and layout. Should the quota already exist on site an additional 4 spaces are still required to be provided and designated for exclusive use by users of the padel courts. The details shall include:o	The location, type, and layout of all cycle parking facilities.o	Compliance with LCDS, including provisions for accessible cycle parking.o	Signage and markings to indicate spaces reserved for padel users.The approved cycle parking shall be installed prior to first use of the development and thereafter permanently retained for cycle parking purposes only.Reason: To ensure adequate cycle parking provision in accordance with Policy T5 of the London Plan (2021) and to support sustainable transport modes.

Prior to occupation of the development, details of refuse storage facilities to be provided within the development should be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details. Reason: In the interests of amenity

The development hereby permitted shall not be in used until the details outlined in the SuDs Strategy and Management Plan (prepared by 4TY Planning, dated 24.09.24) have been implemented. The sustainable drainage system shall be implemented and thereafter managed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD Policy 61, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF and to maximise opportunities for sustainable development, improve water quality, biodiversity, local amenity and recreation value.

Following the practical completion of the development, details outlined at the Energy and Sustainability Statement prepared by Ecolytik, dated Aug 2025 shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority implemented and thereafter managed and maintained in accordance with the approved details. Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to ensure that the Local Planning Authority may be satisfied that CO2 emission reduction targets by renewable energy are met in accordance with Policies DMD51-54 of the Development Management Document (2014) and Policy SI 2 of the New London Plan 2021

Prior to the first use of the padel tennis courts, a Community Use Agreement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, subject to endorsement by Planning Committee members. The agreement shall include details of:a)	Identified user groups and clubsb)	Hours of use for members and non-membersc)	Pricing policy - this shall include court hire discounts for local ward residents, elderly members, young people and other identified individuals (no less than 20% discount)d)	Frequency and duration of community engagement activities, including but not limited to coaching sessions for children and young people at reduced or no coste)	Mechanisms for monitoring and reviewing community participation and access; andf)	Contact details for a named community liaison officer.The approved agreement shall be implemented in full upon commencement of use and the provisions within the agreement shall apply for the lifetime of the development unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To ensure the development provides sufficient public benefits and the facilities are inclusive and accessible to all members of the community.

Prior to the precommencement of the development, a Fire Statement, which is an independent fire strategy produced by a third party, suitably qualified assessor, shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing in consultation with the Fire Commissioner. The approved measures shall be implemented on site prior to the occupation of the development and shall be permanently maintained.Reason: In the interests of the safety of future occupiers and to accord with London Plan Policy D12
